cp30:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi maccharājā mahāsare uṇhe suriyasantāpe sare udakaṃ khīyatha. || ||
cp30:2.1: Tato kākā ca gijjhā ca bakā kulalasenakā bhakkhayanti divārattiṃ macche upanisīdiya. || ||
cp30:3.1: Evaṃ cintes' ahaṃ tattha saha ñātīhi pīḷito: kena nu kho upāyena ñātī dukkhā pamocaye. || ||
cp30:4.1: Vicintayitvā dhammatthaṃ saccaṃ addasa' passayaṃ sacce ṭhatvā pamocesiṃ ñātīnaṃ taṃ atikkhayaṃ. || ||
cp30:5.1: Anussaritvā saddhammaṃ paramatthaṃ vicintayaṃ akāsiṃ saccakiriyaṃ yaṃ loke dhuvasassataṃ: || ||
cp30:6.1: Yato sarāmi attānaṃ yato patto 'smi viññutaṃ nābhijānāmi sañcicca ekapāṇam-pi hiṃsitaṃ
cp30:7.1: etena saccavajjena Pajjunno abhivassatu. || || Abhitthanaya Pajjunna nidhiṃ kākassa nāsaya kākaṃ sokāya rundhehi macche sokā pamocaya. || ||
cp30:8.1: Saha kate saccavare Pajjunno abhigajjiya thalaṃ ninnañca pūrento khaṇena abhivassatha. || ||
cp30:9.1: Evarūpaṃ saccavaraṃ katvā viriyam-uttamaṃ vassāpesiṃ mahāmeghaṃ saccatejabala 'ssito; saccena me samo natthi esā me saccapāramīti. || ||
